    Rasmus "Caps" Borregaard Winther Dónde
     Germany  Cuándo
     15 April 2024 
The record for the most wins of the League of Legends European Championships is 12 and was achieved by "Rasmus "Caps" Borregaard Winther in Berlin, Germany, on 14 April 2024.
Caps, known as King of Hats by his Chinese fan base, was the 2nd player to reach 2000 kills in the LEC and the 4th to reach 300 wins. He also has the most LEC Finals MVPs at 5.
